newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo says Thomson hopes still alive.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo says Thomson hopes still alive.

text.p: The chairman of South Korea's Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd was in Paris, demonstrating the firm's determination to go through with its takeover of France's Thomson Multimedia, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

"Last weekend, chairman Bae Soon-hoon went to Paris, where he is discussing the Thomson deal," said Daewoo Electronics spokesman Park Sung-il. When asked when Daewoo foresaw any developments in the takeover issue, Park said: "We are not in a position to be setting timetables for any announcement. We're waiting for the French government."
Last week, France backed away from its decision to privatise state-owned electronics giant Thomson SA after an independent privatisation committee challenged Daewoo's involvement.
Under the plan, France was to have sold Thomson to electronics group Lagardere for one franc. Lagardere in turn planned to sell loss-making Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo Electronics for one franc.
Daewoo is a unit of the Daewoo Group.
